reviews.title: Great card
reviews.comment:
This is my second PNY card. The 1st was a 3070 which I was hesitant to buy PNY over the other more expensive brands. The 3070 ran great, was extremely quiet and never gets above 70 degrees under full load gaming.
I bought this 4080 for a new build and it runs great as well. Full load 70 degrees and quiet.
No problems with either card. Very pleased.
reviews.author: Jeffrey D. Newell

reviews.title: Very Happy
reviews.comment: Don't expect this to be most peoples experience, but for me this lowered all my system temps by 8-20°. Came from a 3080 FE (blower) and am very happy with silent operation, no coil whine, and it seemingly made my entire airflow situation improve dramatically.
reviews.author: Generic Male
